friends.evidence: WGAW’s January 13, 2016 release credits Kauffman and Crane as co-creators and states that the NBC run was 1994–2004.

seinfeld.evidence: Viacom’s September 21, 2019 release explicitly credits Larry David and Jerry Seinfeld as creators. IMDb and Ext.Street identify the original run as 1989–1998.

sex-and-the-city.evidence: HISTORY identifies the June 1998 premiere, Darren Star as creator, and the original series ending in 2004. The films and And Just Like That are separate works.

gossip-girl.evidence: WBD identifies the original show as developed by Josh Schwartz and Stephanie Savage and broadcast from 2007 to 2012.

succession.evidence: HBO credits creator Jesse Armstrong; NOW lists the completed four-season series as 2018–2023.

the-marvelous-mrs-maisel.evidence: Amazon names Amy Sherman-Palladino as creator in its 2017 premiere announcement and identifies the fifth season as final in April 2023.
